title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: lightning preprocessEngine index engine terminal action is owned by parent importEngines

analysis: The source rule correctly found a syntactic early return: in preprocessEngine, local-backend cancel handling calls dataEngine.Close(context.Background()) and returns the original error if that close fails
The later indexEngine.Flush(ctx) is not in the same error branch. It belongs to the normal path after all chunk processing has completed and dataEngine.Close(ctx) returned without error
The index engine is passed into preprocessEngine by the parent importEngines function. It is not owned solely by the per-data-engine preprocessEngine call

Parent importEngines waits for all data-engine goroutines, then closes indexEngine once at lightning/pkg/importer/table_import.go:601-604, or closes it through UnsafeCloseEngine when resuming a closed checkpoint

Therefore a RED based only on dataEngine.Close failing inside preprocessEngine would not prove a skipped sibling terminal owner. The apparent sibling terminal action is a branch/ownership false positive
source_anchors: lightning/pkg/importer/table_import.go:458-606 importEngines opens/passes indexEngine and closes it after all data engines finish
lightning/pkg/importer/table_import.go:569 preprocessEngine receives indexEngine from parent importEngines
lightning/pkg/importer/table_import.go:921-933 cancel/error branch closes dataEngine only for local-backend checkpoint handling and returns original err
lightning/pkg/importer/table_import.go:936-947 normal branch closes dataEngine, optionally Flushes indexEngine, and saves closed checkpoint
payload.why_not_execute: The target lacks P/Q/F ownership: indexEngine.Flush at line 940 is not a later sibling close skipped by the line 925 error branch. A unit test forcing line 925 to return would only prove a syntactic branch, not a product terminal-action bug.
payload.method_lesson: The terminal-action source rule must be followed by branch/owner proof. A candidate is executable only if the later terminal action is owned by the same higher-level operation on the same error path, or no parent/defer path can satisfy the terminal obligation.
payload.next_step: Continue with the next terminal-action candidate, preferably pkg/dxf/importinto/task_executor.onFinished or pkg/ingestor/simplesst/writer.flushSortedKVs, where the sibling owner appears to be in the same terminal sequence.
